A1.justification: Both 45-page PDFs describe the same research work and contain the main text and Appendices A–N. Text and rendered-page comparisons support matching the equations, figures, tables, and appendices without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original crosscoder training and evaluation, KL-divergence intervention experiments, interpretability measurements, and latent steering results in Section 3 and the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the additional model/domain experiments in Appendix I and qualitative and steering experiments in Appendix N.

M1.justification: The crosscoder architectures, sparsity losses, inference rules, and Latent Scaling optimization remain unchanged in Section 2 and Appendices B and E. The corrected diagnostic formula does not establish a change to the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same web/chat data and medical and reasoning coverage, including FineWeb, LMSYS, and the domain-specific comparisons in Appendix I. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The same L1 and BatchTopK comparisons and intervention baselines remain, including None, All, Error, norm-based ranking, Latent Scaling, and template-token interventions. Comparator participation is unchanged.

E3.justification: Equation (3)'s reported norm-difference metric gains the shift and scaling required for its stated [0,1] range. Existing classification thresholds, sample sizes, training settings, and intervention procedures remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The alternative BatchTopK variants, scaling and decoupling analyses, cross-model checks, and qualitative and steering cases are retained. Their experimental designs, prompts, and qualitative findings are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same 95% confidence-interval reporting in Figures 4 and 13 and the same correlation and significance reporting. No run-count, seed, or statistical estimation information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All 20 Δnorm entries in Tables 5 and 6 change to one minus their earlier values. For example, BatchTopK latent 70149 changes from 0.064 to 0.936, and L1 latent 72073 from 0.097 to 0.903. Other columns, reported ranks, and experimental findings remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation (3) and the Appendix A glossary replace q with (1+q)/2, where q is the chat-minus-base decoder norm divided by their maximum. This repairs the inconsistency with the stated base-only, shared, and chat-only endpoints of 0, 0.5, and 1. Other derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same claims about L1 shrinkage and decoupling artifacts, Latent Scaling's diagnostic role, and BatchTopK's identification of causal, interpretable chat-specific latents.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Section 5 retains the limitations concerning small models and middle layers, information in reconstruction errors, and distinguishing newly learned concepts from shifted activation patterns.

D1.justification: Implementation details, training hyperparameters, preprocessing instructions, computational budgets, and code/model access links are unchanged. No additional reproducibility information is disclosed.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, bibliography, prior-work attribution, and research positioning are unchanged. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: Appendix N.1 removes a dangling 'In figure' fragment and incorporates the existing chat-token abbreviation footnote into the paragraph. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; the narrative and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded equation and glossary entry, together with the footnote relocation, produce small local layout changes on pages 3, 21, and 36. Figures and table structures, placements, and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 resolves two concrete consistency problems: Equation (3) now matches the stated [0,1] interpretation, and Tables 5–6 place the illustrated chat-only latents above 0.9 instead of below 0.1. These corrections improve mathematical accuracy and reporting consistency, alongside a small prose cleanup. The empirical evidence, claims, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is limited.
